programmes.title: NEWS GENERATION [L]
programmes.desc: NEWs Generation is Arirang TV’s daily news program covering latest trends and current affairs affecting people in their twenties and thirties. It opens discussions with millennial and Gen Z panelists and experts who would like to share their insight and firsthand experience on various topics of interest.

programmes.title: MOO NO PLAN
programmes.desc: A no-rules, real-life food documentary that unfolds somewhere between No Plan and Jun Hyun-moo’s Plan. The show explores local restaurants and hot spots recommended by neighborhood residents. With the production team staying completely out of it, Jun Hyun-moo and KwakTube build their own travel itinerary as they go, venturing off the beaten path to discover hidden gems that locals swear by. ※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.
